# AGENTS.md - docker-mods branch swag-auto-uptime-kuma

## Purpose

This branch is the Docker Mod `swag-auto-uptime-kuma`, published as
`ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:swag-auto-uptime-kuma`. A mod is a single-layer `FROM scratch` image whose files are
extracted over `/` when a container starts with `DOCKER_MODS=` set.

## Layout and what you may edit

| Path | Edit? | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Dockerfile` | yes | `FROM scratch` + `COPY root/ /`, or a multi-stage build that ends the same way. |
| `root/` | yes | `etc/s6-overlay/s6-rc.d/init-mod-swag-auto-uptime-kuma*` and `svc-mod-swag-auto-uptime-kuma`. |
| `mod.yml` | yes | Metadata the hub indexes. Schema: `https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/builder/blob/main/schemas/mod.schema.json` |
| `README.md`, `AGENTS.md` | no | Generated from `mod.yml`. |
| `.github/workflows/build.yml` | no | Generated; calls `linuxserver-playground/workflows` mod-build. |

## Rules

- Never call `apk`, `apt` or `pip` directly; append to `/mod-repo-packages-to-install.list` or
  `/mod-pip-packages-to-install.list`. Handle Alpine and Ubuntu names when `bases` lists both.
- Oneshots depend on `init-mods`; package-installing mods are a dependency of `init-mods-package-install`,
  the rest of `init-mods-end`. Services depend on `init-services`. Register in `user/contents.d/`.
- Most good mods are 10 to 40 lines. If yours is not, reconsider the approach.
- Commit and PR titles: `swag: auto-uptime-kuma <short description>`. Squash before merging.

## Validate locally

```bash
docker build -t mod:test .
# DOCKER_MODS= only resolves registry images, so a local build is sideloaded as a tar of its single layer:
docker create --name mod-test mod:test true && mkdir -p /tmp/mods && docker export mod-test > /tmp/mods/swag-auto-uptime-kuma.tar && docker rm mod-test
docker run --rm -e DOCKER_MODS_SIDELOAD=true -v /tmp/mods:/mods -e PUID=1000 -e PGID=1000 ghcr.io/linuxserver/swag:latest
```

`tools/test-mod.sh` on the `master` branch of docker-mods automates this.
